{{nihongo|'''Tomi Shrine'''|登彌神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Tomi Shrine''' (とみじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/1273537/1/44 |title=Engishiki Jinmeichō |access-date=2024-5-24}}</ref> {{ill|Louis de Bourbon, Duke of Montpensier|Q927365|qid=Q927365}} in Ishiki-chō, {{ill|Nara (city)|Q169134|qid=Q169134}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. Its former shrine rank was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=prefectural shrine|qid=Q90139226}} (ranked in {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 14). Ritual {{ill|Earthenware|Q1377111|qid=Q1377111}} has been excavated from Myōjin-yama north of the shrine.

According to tradition, the origin is that on Kōki 4 (spring, February 23), {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|Q200188|qid=Q200188}} worshiped the {{ill|Ancestors of the Emperor|Q11581090|qid=Q11581090|lt=imperial heavenly ancestors}} (or {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}) at this place. Later, the Tomi-no-Muraji clan enshrined Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto and his consort in this area where their ancestor had resided. Including smaller shrines, 22 deities are worshiped<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://ntomishrine.wixsite.com/official |title=Tomi Shrine |access-date=2024-5-24}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The honden faces south, with western and eastern honden side by side. Deities of the western honden are {{ill|Kamimusubi|es|Kami-musubi-no-kami|fr|Kamimusubi|id|Kamimusubi|it|Kamimusubi|ja|カムムスヒ|mni|ꯀꯃꯤꯃꯨꯁꯨꯕꯤ|pl|Kamimusubi|ru|Камимусуби-но ками|sk|Kamimusubi|sv|Kami-Musubi|zh|神皇產靈尊|qid=Q3275901|lt=Kamimusubi-no-Kami}}, Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto, and {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508}}; deities of the eastern honden are {{ill|Takamimusubi|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi-no-Kami}} and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Honda-wake-no-Mikoto}}. Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto is also called Tomi Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto and Kijima Daimyōjin.

=== Cultural properties ===
*On April 3, Reiwa 2, the honden, haiden, shinsenjo, chōzuya, and shrine office were registered as national tangible cultural properties by the Agency for Cultural Affairs.
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kayu uranai}} was designated an intangible folk cultural property of Nara City on March 1, Shōwa 57.
=== Precinct shrines ===
*Haraedo Shrine (deities: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Seoritsuhime-no-Kami}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Hayakitsuhime-no-Kami}}, {{ill|Ibukidonushi no Kami|Q86734190|qid=Q86734190}}, {{ill|Hayasasurahime|Q136731213|qid=Q136731213}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Uwatsutsuno-o-no-Kami}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nakatsutsuno-o-no-Kami}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sokotsutsuno-o-no-Kami}})
*Yamamuro Shrine (deities: {{ill|Ōmononushi|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi-no-Kami}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sugawara no Michizane-kō}})
*Toyoho Shrine (deities: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōhirume-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Toyoukehime-no-Kami}}, Ame-no-Uzume-no-Kami)
*Kōjin Shrine (deities: {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi-no-Kami}}, Niwatakatsuhi-no-Kami)
*Hirata Shrine (deities: {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|lt=Sarutahiko-no-Kami|qid=Q3090037}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Kami}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yae-Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}})

=== Access ===
*2 km west from {{ill|Kujō Station (Nara)|Q6442373|qid=Q6442373|lt=Kujō Station}} on the {{ill|Kashihara Line|Q2491066|qid=Q2491066}} (about 20 minutes on foot)

*Parking available
